opennyai_summary.decision:
Sri Mohammad Adnan, learned Standing Counsel for TSGENCO, appearing for respondent No.3,
submitted that TSGENCO has already taken a decision to acquire the land of the petitioner and to pay compensation in accordance with the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as 'Act, 2013').
Within a period of two weeks, TSGENCO will make a request to the acquisition authority to take appropriate steps for acquiring the land by issuing the necessary notification under the provisions of the Act, 2013.
2. Recording the above submissions, the Contempt Case is closed.
However, if the requisitioning authority fails to submit the request for acquisition of the petitioner's land, or if the land acquisition authority does not initiate the land acquisition proceedings, the petitioner is granted liberty to seek reopening of the present Contempt Case.
Pending miscellaneous applications, if any, shall stand closed.
